slides.text: Not sure how to get found online? I'm here to help you with that.
Getting you found online is my whole thing
Hi, I'm Mercedes. I help you get found online and turn that attention into customers.

I spent years in financial operations and reporting.
Numbers are my comfort zone.
I kept coming up with business ideas, then getting stuck at the same spot: selling them.
So I learned marketing the way I learn everything: break it down, build a system, test it.
The Ambition Department is for you if you want to make money online, or grow your business, without weeks of setup or paying for ads.
I love helping small businesses and solopreneurs carve out an income in a world built for big companies.
Comment PLAN and I'll send you the plan for your first $1,000. Go get 'em, tiger :)

caption: Comment PLAN and I'll send you the plan for your first $1,000. I'm Mercedes, and I started The Ambition Department after years of having business ideas I didn't know how to sell. I'm an analyst at heart, so I learned marketing the only way I know how: break it into steps, build systems, and test what works. Now I share those systems so you don't have to build them from scratch. Follow along for practical tips on getting found online and turning it into sales.
